notes:
SUMMARY: Mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Hosted API first; positive API trial telemetry, now moving to Dedicated capacity sizing and procurement. Hosted trial (6 weeks): ran two canaries (NA/EU), instrumented tracing, pulled token-level cost data. Key asks from CTO: "p50 latency under 300ms; predictable unit cost; EU-sited residency and audit trail". Workload: primary support chat (conversational UI embedded in product) ~92% of traffic, doc-search embeddings for knowledge base ~6%, occasional reranking calls for top-K suggestions ~2%.

TRIAL HIGHLIGHTS: fragments/notes from SE sessions -
- Week 1: quick integration, auth via API key + IP allowlist; basic logging enabled.
- Week 2: observed mean tokens/request 420 (prompt 150 / completion 270), cost sensitivity flagged by finance.
- Week 3: spike test (PR event) produced 48 QPS peak; backend queueing surfaced at >80 concurrent streams.
- Week 4: latency profiling showed p95 ~480ms on hosted small model; quantized variant cut CPU time and reduced cost ~35% but p95 still ~360ms.
- Week 5: SE tuned batching windows; p50 fell to ~230ms in NA region; EU observed slightly higher NVMe latency.
- Week 6: wrap - product team requests Dedicated sizing to hit p50 <250ms and absorb 2x event bursts.

PROCUREMENT & SECURITY: Legal requests: Data Processing Addendum, EU residency SLA, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration. Security team filed SEC-462 asking for encryption-at-rest details and audit log retention policy. Finance is asking for committed discount if we sign a 12-mo Dedicated plan.

QUOTES/VERBATIM: - CTO Jenna Alvarez: "We need latency and cost predictability or we can't route customer traffic to hosted buckets." - Head of Product Marco: "If Dedicated keeps p50 sub-250 with 30% lower unit cost vs hosted, we pull forward GA."

NEXTS: deliver Dedicated sizing + binding price options (monthly commit tiers + burst pricing), validate EU residency capability, coordinate procurement call (week of 2026-03-15). Short blockers: legal DPA review, confirm SLA matrix for p50/p95, finalize GPU type for Dedicated pool.
